name: Standing Dumbbell Strict Press
grip: Overhand or slightly turned inward, with straight wrists and forearms beneath the dumbbells.
description: Press two dumbbells from shoulder height to overhead while standing without leg drive.
setup: Stand with feet about hip-width and bring a dumbbell to each shoulder.
Position the elbows slightly forward of the torso, brace the trunk and balance over the whole foot.
instructions: Press both dumbbells overhead without bending and driving through the knees.
Allow the shoulder blades to rotate upward as the arms rise.
Finish with the weights balanced over the shoulders and torso steady.
Lower to shoulder height under control.
commonMistakes: Leaning backward to finish the press.
Turning the movement into a push press with leg drive.

logging.example: Two 12 kg dumbbells: record 12 kg per dumbbell.
logging.note: Keep the same exercise variant and record each dumbbell's mass rather than the combined pair.

variantNote: Standing, simultaneous two-dumbbell press. Seated and alternating presses are separate variants.
